facts.fact: Baker Birikujja, the National Personal Data Protection director, says the Personal Data Protection Office is the national regulator, operating independently under NITA-U and enforcing the Data Protection and Privacy Act.

UGA.note: No ruling by the office itself is stated; the July 2025 conviction is a court outcome.

facts.fact: The director says the Personal Data Protection Office enforces the Data Protection and Privacy Act, and that the first conviction under it came in July 2025.
The director says the Personal Data Protection Office, under NITA-U, is the operating national regulator for data protection.
The director says the office enforces the Act and its attendant regulations.
The director says Uganda achieved its first conviction under the Data Protection and Privacy Act in July 2025.
The director says the office enforces the Data Protection and Privacy Act, with a first conviction under it in July 2025.
The Personal Data Protection Office, under NITA-U, is described by its director as the national regulator doing the supervisory job.
The director says the office keeps the national register of data controllers, handles complaints, runs compliance clinics, and audits and inspects large data handlers.

UGA.note: It says Uganda is aligned with international standards in general terms and joins forums; no ISO or IEC membership or named standard.
It names no government-run system or technology body building systems for government; the office's digital tools for registration are not tied to staff-built systems.
